# opstracer_schedule (Resource)

An on-call schedule. Each layer is a rotation; when layers overlap, the later layer wins.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opstracer_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

data "opstracer_user" "bob" {
  email = "bob@example.com"
}

# Weekly rotation, plus a business-hours layer where both are on call together.
resource "opstracer_schedule" "backend" {
  name      = "Backend on-call"
  time_zone = "Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh"

  layers = [
    {
      name                  = "Weekly primary"
      rotation_start_at     = "2026-10-19T09:00:00+07:00"
      member_period_seconds = 604800
      participant_groups    = [[data.opstracer_user.alice.id], [data.opstracer_user.bob.id]]
    },
    {
      name                  = "Business hours"
      rotation_start_at     = "2026-10-19T09:00:00+07:00"
      member_period_seconds = 86400
      participant_groups    = [[data.opstracer_user.alice.id, data.opstracer_user.bob.id]]
      restrictions = [
        { days = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], start_time_of_day = 32400, duration_seconds = 28800 },
      ]
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `layers` (Attributes List) Rotations, in order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layers))
- `name` (String) Schedule name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone, e.g. `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh`. Defaults to the org time zone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Schedule ID.

<a id="nestedatt--layers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layers`

Required:

- `member_period_seconds` (Number) Length of one turn. 86400 = daily, 604800 = weekly.
- `participant_groups` (List of List of String) Turns in rotation order. Each turn is a list of user IDs on call together.
- `rotation_start_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the first turn starts, e.g. `2026-10-14T09:00:00+07:00`.

Optional:

- `name` (String) Layer name.
- `restrictions` (Attributes List) Limit the layer to these windows. Leave unset for around-the-clock coverage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--layers--restrictions))
- `time_zone` (String) Defaults to the schedule time zone.

<a id="nestedatt--layers--restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `layers.restrictions`

Required:

- `days` (Set of Number) ISO weekdays: 1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday.
- `duration_seconds` (Number) Length of the window in seconds. 28800 = 8 hours.
- `start_time_of_day` (Number) Seconds after midnight in the layer time zone. 32400 = 09:00.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opstracer_schedule.backend <schedule-id>
```
